verdict.rationale: AiPrise offers APIs, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question, but probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404, and no doc mentions a published spec. The llms.txt and markdown docs are LLM-oriented documentation, not an API specification, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
